principle: Keep canonical time-bar scan; add information-driven event sampling without changing ranking until OOS validation.

runtime.promotion_requirement: separate OOS validation using forward outcomes; no promotion from in-sample unit tests

safeguards: ambiguous same-bar barrier hits are not force-labeled
microstructure failures do not fail the main scan
no ranking/category override until real forward OOS promotion gate passes
tick and volume bars are derived from trade-level input, not reconstructed from OHLCV
alternative-bar calibration and evaluation segments are time-ordered and non-overlapping
threshold-closing trade is not synthetically split across bars
partial alternative-bar tails are dropped rather than force-closed

integrity.mtf_rule: higher-timeframe features are only available when closeTime < decisionTime
integrity.duplicate_policy: dedupe by openTime for candles and aggregate-trade id/composite key for aggTrades
integrity.threshold_guard: calibrationEndTime must be strictly before evaluationStartTime; evaluation/future trades cannot alter frozen thresholds

threshold_policy.rule: derive thresholds only from the leading calibration segment; freeze them for the later evaluation segment
threshold_policy.rolling_mode: retained as shadow diagnostic comparison only

overshoot_policy.rule: the trade that crosses a volume/notional/imbalance threshold remains wholly in the closing bar; excess is measured but not synthetically split or carried
